sections.text: Good morning. Here is what is worth knowing today.

SAIL: Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop. SAIL: Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop We introduce SAIL, an open model with 35B total and 3B active parameters for literature research, scientific coding, and multi-step research workflows.

When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation. When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory.

Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals. Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals On-policy distillation (OPD) enables effective capability transfer between language models, yet the mechanisms underlying its failures are not fully understood.

MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement. MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute.
